19	import java.util.Map;
20	
21	/**
22	 * Helpers for the "locality" (region) a pet owner belongs to. The locality is the canonical region
23	 * derived by preferring the owner's postcode: a postcode that falls in a known region's range decides
24	 * the region, and only when the postcode is absent or in no known range does the fixed city-to-region
25	 * table decide it. A city that is not in the table (and no matching postcode) has the locality
26	 * {@code "UNKNOWN"}.
27	 */
28	public final class Localities {
29	
30	    /**
31	     * Fixed city-to-region table. Any city not listed derives the locality {@link #UNKNOWN}.
32	     */
33	    private static final Map<String, String> CITY_REGION = Map.of(
34	        "Sydney", "NSW",
35	        "Melbourne", "VIC",
36	        "Brisbane", "QLD");
37	
38	    /**
39	     * Fixed region-to-postcode-range table: a 4-digit postcode within a region's inclusive range
40	     * ({@code NSW 2000-2099}, {@code VIC 3000-3099}, {@code QLD 4000-4099}) derives that region.
41	     */
42	    private static final Map<String, int[]> REGION_POSTCODE_RANGES = Map.of(
43	        "NSW", new int[] {2000, 2099},
44	        "VIC", new int[] {3000, 3099},
45	        "QLD", new int[] {4000, 4099});
46	
47	    /**
48	     * Fixed region-to-timezone table: each canonical region maps to its IANA timezone name
49	     * ({@code NSW -> Australia/Sydney}, {@code VIC -> Australia/Melbourne},
50	     * {@code QLD -> Australia/Brisbane}).
51	     */
52	    private static final Map<String, String> REGION_TIMEZONE = Map.of(
53	        "NSW", "Australia/Sydney",
54	        "VIC", "Australia/Melbourne",
55	        "QLD", "Australia/Brisbane");
56	
57	    /**
58	     * Locality returned for any city not present in the {@link #CITY_REGION fixed table}.
59	     */
60	    public static final String UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN";
61	
62	    private Localities() {
63	    }
64	
65	    /**
66	     * Returns the canonical region for the given city from the fixed city-to-region table
67	     * ({@code Sydney -> NSW}, {@code Melbourne -> VIC}, {@code Brisbane -> QLD}), or
68	     * {@link #UNKNOWN} when the city ({@code null} included) is not in the table.
69	     *
70	     * @param city the owner's city
71	     * @return the canonical region string, or {@code "UNKNOWN"} when the city is not in the table
72	     */
73	    public static String region(String city) {
74	        return CITY_REGION.getOrDefault(city, UNKNOWN);
75	    }
76	
77	    /**
78	     * Returns the canonical region for an owner, preferring the postcode. The region is looked up by
79	     * postcode range first ({@code NSW 2000-2099}, {@code VIC 3000-3099}, {@code QLD 4000-4099}); only
80	     * when the postcode is absent, not a 4-digit number, or in no known range does it fall back to the
81	     * {@link #region(String) city-to-region table}. For a known city with a matching postcode this
82	     * returns the same region as the city alone, but a postcode disambiguates cities that share a name.
83	     *
84	     * @param postcode the owner's postcode, may be {@code null}
85	     * @param city the owner's city
86	     * @return the canonical region string, or {@code "UNKNOWN"} when neither postcode nor city resolves
87	     */
88	    public static String region(String postcode, String city) {
89	        String fromPostcode = regionForPostcode(postcode);
90	        return fromPostcode != null ? fromPostcode : region(city);
91	    }
92	
93	    /**
94	     * Returns the IANA timezone name for an owner's locality, derived from the region resolved by
95	     * {@link #region(String, String)} via the fixed region-to-timezone table
96	     * ({@code NSW -> Australia/Sydney}, {@code VIC -> Australia/Melbourne},
97	     * {@code QLD -> Australia/Brisbane}), or {@code null} when the region has no known timezone
98	     * (including the {@link #UNKNOWN} locality).
99	     *
100	     * @param postcode the owner's postcode, may be {@code null}
101	     * @param city the owner's city
102	     * @return the IANA timezone name, or {@code null} when the locality has no known timezone
103	     */
104	    public static String timezone(String postcode, String city) {
105	        return REGION_TIMEZONE.get(region(postcode, city));
106	    }
107	
108	    /**
109	     * Returns the region whose inclusive range contains the given postcode, or {@code null} when the
110	     * postcode is {@code null}, not a 4-digit number, or in no known range.
111	     */
112	    private static String regionForPostcode(String postcode) {
113	        if (postcode == null || !postcode.matches("[0-9]{4}")) {
114	            return null;
115	        }
116	        int value = Integer.parseInt(postcode);
117	        for (Map.Entry<String, int[]> entry : REGION_POSTCODE_RANGES.entrySet()) {
118	            int[] range = entry.getValue();
119	            if (value >= range[0] && value <= range[1]) {
120	                return entry.getKey();
121	            }
122	        }
123	        return null;
124	    }
125	}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is combined with the last name to form the owner's
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred over this flat value. On a successful create the returned
            'address' is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized on create (surrounding
            whitespace trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased and common
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized on create the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and the result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            E.164 value (e.g. '+61412345678') is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be exactly
            4 digits and valid for the owner's city per a fixed region-to-range
            table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. The value is stored and
            returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-16'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is stored and used to derive the owner's ageBand
            relative to their registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even if
            another owner already has the same last name and address (i.e. the
            two share a household). Ignored otherwise and never stored.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner resource, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as '<title> <lastName>' when a
                title was supplied, or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last names,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot (e.g. 'J.S.').
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A code assigned on create, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is
                a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the
                number of owners at the time of creation (e.g. 'SMI-0007').
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit computed over the decimal digits contained
                in the owner's customerCode (non-digit characters are ignored),
                from 0 to 9.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, shared identifier for the owner's household (owners with
                the same last name at the same address). It is derived
                deterministically from the normalized last name and address, so
                every owner in the same household is assigned the same value,
                formatted 'HH-<12 upper-case hex chars>' (e.g. 'HH-3A7F9C2E1B08').
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the
                identity-bearing fields into a single value formatted
                '<telephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>' (e.g.
                '+61412345678||HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'). Duplicate detection is expressed
                solely through this key.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners at the time of creation that share
                this owner's first and last name, compared case-insensitively
                (i.e. excluding this owner itself).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate falls in, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so
                1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A code derived from the owner's own fields, formatted
                '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year of the registrationDate (see fiscalYear), e.g.
                'SMI-0007-M26'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from their own fields.
                Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or more; adds 3
                for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level derived from their
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or
                more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), absent
                when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the time it was created. True once
                that day's owner count exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                at the time it was created, approaching the hard capacity limit
                of 50. True when the city's owner count was in that range,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, at the time it was created, was a soft match
                for an existing owner: not a hard duplicate, but sharing an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. True when such a match existed, otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner softly matched on
                creation (same last name and postcode, different telephone).
                Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from their birthDate relative to
                their registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Present only when a birthDate was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true and retains the record,
                and a deleted owner is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and
                identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

## Summary

I implemented the `ownerSegment` derived field on the Owner API, formatted `<TIER>_<AREA>`.
